reason: Host environments retained inherited Git configuration variables, so Git credential paths were not fail-closed.
review_mode: detached full-access process with no edit, network, push, PR, merge, or broad-test instruction
remediation: The host environment now removes every inherited GIT_, GH_, GITHUB_, and SSH_ variable before setting its minimal safe Git configuration.
A focused regression test injects credential-helper, GitHub token, and SSH-agent variables and verifies none reach the host.
